author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
My experience is complete opposite conclusion to this article.  AI makes software engineering a life long career.

For the past two decades, I can't keep up with all those new frameworks and programming languages.  I am slowly losing my competitiveness against the younger generation who learn the shinny new things 

With the help of AI, I can skip those synthetic sugars, let AI build directly on top of my battle harder applied computational theory experience.  Latency, memory bottleneck, data structure, algorithms, those foundational knowledge are timeless and it will never go out of date.
